verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate, and overrides that force specific users into a variant for testing or QA. Its first-feature tutorial also targets internal testers, so per-user allowlisting is a first-party capability. Explicit exclusion of individual users is not documented, and the evidence gives little detail on how overrides are configured. Missing for 10: documented per-user exclusion/denylist, detail on override configuration (IDs, lists, segments), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.
set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
